title: The Letters That Led Him to Hogwarts #Fantasy
description:
Letters flood the Dursleys’ home. Soon Harry is on the Hogwarts Express, trying on the Sorting Hat and facing a chessboard that fights back. A trailer for Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone (2001), edited from key scenes across the film.
